# The ABCD study

The Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) study is a long term study of pediatric development tracking patients from 21 research sites across the United States.

## MTBI in ABCD

Four studies have previously investigated mTBI using the ABCD dataset. 

* Guberman et al., 2022 @YBZQILQ8#Guberman_Etal_2022
* Cook and Iversion, 2021 @LJNVCZAQ#Cook_Iverson_2021
* Cook, Karr, Iverson, 2022 @R8GH75M8#Cook_Karr_Iverson_2022
* Dufour et al., 2020 @HFXNXFZS#Dufour_Etal_2020
